First time? Here's the drill

a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.

Check
Look at @bluelinebikelab the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Blue Line Wednesday Ride group ride

A midweek road ride from the Heights shop. About 20 miles at 17 to 20 mph. Helmets and lights are mandatory. The ride needs an experienced leader and gets cancelled when one is not available, so confirm with the shop first.
